messages:
julia: Hey team — draft release notes for v1.8.3 are ready, need review & internal announce timing. aiming for a staged blast: internal -> beta customers -> public.

mike: thanks. can we pin the model-version string in RN? ops prefers explicit pin: `model:v1.8.3-rc2` so rollbacks are clear.

sara: +1 on explicit pin. also we should include the canary window and expected latency delta in the note so support has context.

julia: good call. proposed cadence: internal announce at T+30m before canary, canary 20m, scale-up at +90m. internal message should list rollback criteria and oncall.

emily: need localization heads up — EU docs team needs 3 hours to patch localized snippets. can we delay public blast until they ack?

julia: we can. plan: internal @ 15:00 UTC, canary 15:30, locale ack by 18:30, public 19:00 UTC (if all green). if localizers miss ack, fallback to minimal public note and link to english RN.

deploybot: DeployBot scheduled: rollout v1.8.3 -> cluster-prod-2 at 2025-06-12T15:30:00Z. Canary 50 users / 5 pods. Auto-rollback threshold: error-rate > 1.5% for 5m OR latency p95 increase > 200ms.

mike: DeployBot: pls add a soft-fallback model variant in routing policy (model:v1.8.3-quant) for <60s tail. if canary shows quality regressions we fallback to v1.8.2-pinned.

deploybot: Update acknowledged. Fallback routing set: primary=model:v1.8.3-rc2, fallback=model:v1.8.3-quant, emergency=model:v1.8.2-pinned.

sara: For the internal announce copy, I'm proposing two snippets: short (ops) and long (product/support). Short = bullet list of changes, metrics, rollback triggers. Long = brief summary + example prompt/response delta + links to dashboard & playbook.

julia: paste candidate snippets below so we can sign off.

julia: ```
Short (ops):
- v1.8.3 (model:v1.8.3-rc2) rollout to cluster-prod-2
- Canary @ 15:30 UTC (50 users) -> scale @ +90m if healthy
- Auto-rollback: error-rate >1.5% (5m) OR p95 +200ms
- Fallback: model:v1.8.3-quant -> emergency: model:v1.8.2-pinned
- Oncall: @ops_oncall, escalation: emily
```

emily: looks good. add the console links (dash + trace). also add note about embeddings unit cost increase (~3%) so finance aware.

julia: updated long snippet: ```
Long (product/support):
v1.8.3 updates transformer attention kernel + prefix-cache tuning to reduce cold-starts. Expect ~6-8% lower median latency, p95 may vary with long-context prompts.
Examples: prompt A -> faster response, prompt B -> identical quality.
Canary schedule: 15:30 UTC. Dash: https://console.redwood/dash/abc123. Trace: https://console.redwood/trace/xyz789
Rollback criteria and runbook: https://confluence.redwood/rls/runbook-1-8-3
Cost note: token-unit cost delta ~+3% due to kernel changes.
```

mike: Approved from infra side. just flagging: if we hit the p95 threshold but no errors, we should convene quick triage (15 min) before blind rollback — sometimes p95 blips with traffic changes.

julia: agree — add escalation step: rapid triage -> hold -> rollback if unresolved in 15m. I'll post final internal announce at 14:45 UTC to allow ops review.

ops_oncall: I'll be watching canary and ready to flip rollout. pls ping here when canary begins.

julia: thanks all — final internal announce scheduled 14:45 UTC. will tag @ops_oncall, @emily, @mike. will postpone public blast until localization ack. :thumbsup:
